about: With more than 40 cases resulting in million-dollar recoveries for catastrophically injured clients, Marc Rothenberg has achieved a distinguished record of exceptional results. In 2022, he secured a record-setting $25 Million settlement arising from a truck crash—the largest reported motorcyclist settlement in New York State history. He also obtained the largest known recovery against a major automotive manufacturer in 2018 for a victim of a defective Takata airbag, part of the largest automotive recall in history.

Marc's multi-million dollar recoveries include: $25 million for a motorcyclist struck by truck crash causing traumatic brain injury and quadriplegia; $18 million for auto product defect causing traumatic brain injury;
